The page-break artifact '-131-' appearing at the start of slot 6.01(b)(6)#1 was treated as non-material formatting and not inventoried as a quantitative value.
Clause (11) is cut off mid-list at the end of this batch ('bid,'); only the portion supplied was inventoried (s41), and the remainder of that basket (if any) is out of scope for this batch.

Self-referential cross-references within this batch's operative text to Section 6.01(b)(7), Section 6.01(b)(8) and Section 6.01(b)(9) (each appearing in the 'deemed not permitted by this Section...' consequence clauses) were inventoried as REFERENCE-flagged items (s25, s34, s38) pointing back to their own enclosing provisions.
